label: Weekly Ritual
title: The Weekly Self-Care Reset
subtitle: Once a week, give your skin the full spa treatment it deserves.
description: Daily routines keep you maintained, but the weekly ritual is where you go all out. Exfoliate, mask, hydrate, repeat. It's part skincare, part therapy — your designated 'me time' to slow down and glow up.

benefits.title: Exfoliation = Instant Smoothness
benefits.desc: Sloughing off dead skin once a week reveals the fresh, glowy layer hiding underneath.

benefits.title: Masks That Actually Work
benefits.desc: A targeted mask delivers a concentrated hit your daily routine just can't match.

benefits.title: Products Absorb Way Better
benefits.desc: Clear skin = your serums sink in deeper. Everything you use after just works harder.

benefits.title: Stress Relief Built In
benefits.desc: Slowing down for 30 mins lowers cortisol — which literally shows up as calmer, clearer skin.

benefits.title: Resets Your Whole Week
benefits.desc: It's a ritual, not a chore. One reset day keeps your skin (and mind) on track all week.

steps: Cleanse, then exfoliate gently — chemical (AHA/BHA) over harsh scrubs to avoid micro-tears.
Steam your face or use a warm towel for 2-3 mins to open everything up.
Apply a mask matched to your goal: clay for oil, hydrating for dryness, brightening for dullness.
Rinse, then layer a hydrating toner and a nourishing serum on damp skin.
Seal with a rich moisturizer and a few drops of facial oil. Light a candle. You earned it.

info.heading: How often, really?
info.body: Once a week is the sweet spot for most. Sensitive skin? Every 10 days. Don't exfoliate daily — it wrecks your barrier.

info.heading: Make it a vibe
info.body: Phone away, playlist on, warm tea nearby. The ritual works best when you actually slow down for it.

faqs.q: Scrub or chemical exfoliant — which is better?
faqs.a: Chemical (AHA/BHA) is gentler and more even. Physical scrubs feel satisfying but can cause tiny tears. If you scrub, go super soft.

faqs.q: Can I use multiple masks at once?
faqs.a: Yes! It's called multi-masking — clay on your T-zone, hydrating on dry cheeks. Customize it to whatever your skin needs that day.

faqs.q: My skin gets red after exfoliating, normal?
faqs.a: A little flush is okay, but stinging or lasting redness means you overdid it. Dial back the frequency and always follow with hydration.

faqs.q: Is a weekly ritual really necessary?
faqs.a: Not life-or-death, but it makes a visible difference and feels amazing. Think of it as the difference between surviving and actually thriving.

proTip: Do your weekly ritual on a Sunday night. You'll head into the week with reset skin and a calmer headspace — the ultimate soft-life flex.
